🎤 Brush Song recorder

Wear headphones (wired if possible) so the backing doesn't leak into the recording. Pick a verse, press Practise to learn it with the guide tune, then Record. There are 2 bars of clicks to count you in. Each verse is exactly 30 seconds. Download the takes you like and send them to Claude in the chat.

1. What to sing

Guide tune Backing

2. Practise or record

Mic level

3. Your takes

Takes appear here. They're only kept until you close the page, so download the good ones.

Prefer to record in another app?

Download the backing (with the same 2-bar count-in), play it in your headphones from one device and record your voice on another, e.g. Voice Memos or GarageBand. Start the recording a moment before you press play on the backing.
